name: live-trader-prediction-fixes
description: Fix live trader prediction issues: zeros returned, excessive data fetching, insufficient bars. Trigger when: (1) all predictions show signal=0 and confidence=0.0, (2) live trader continuously fetches thousands of bars, (3) 'Insufficient data' warnings in prediction logs, (4) Markov features show uniform priors [0.33, 0.34, 0.33].
